title: Bared Footwear
outcome: Content on three platforms through a growth phase
summary: Social media and marketing content for a Melbourne footwear brand during a busy growth phase. I was on the retail team at the same time, which is where I contributed to the Lightspeed to Shopify Plus migration.

stats.label: Shopify Plus migration, from the retail side

sections.head: Keeping the brand sharp while scaling fast
sections.body: Bared was growing quickly — new stores, new product lines, a lot happening at once. Alongside that, they were migrating their eCommerce platform from Lightspeed to Shopify Plus, which touched everything from inventory to reporting.

sections.head: Consistent content and a cleaner digital foundation
sections.body: Keep the social presence running consistently across Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, with content that feels intentional rather than churned out to fill a grid, and help the retail team through the platform change.

sections.head: Stronger content, better systems
sections.body: I produced and managed content across all three platforms, including product photography and video. As part of the retail role I contributed to the Lightspeed to Shopify Plus migration, improving how the store handled inventory, reporting and overall functionality. Being on the shop floor meant the content was more genuine and the marketing better informed.
